name: watchface_reset_watchface

provenance.source: exact 3.101.043 IDB vela_ap.bin.i64 sub_C5F36C0; own "reset_watchface" log tag plus refresh_cur_watchface callee review

notes: Rebuilds the current watchface after a face is deleted; stock callers include remove_multi_watchface. The single argument is the force flag forwarded to refresh_cur_watchface (0x0c5f32b8): 0 refreshes only when the current watchface record changed, nonzero forces destroy/create. Upstream commit ad07252 reached the same code through the 0x2C5F36C0 read-only data mirror; this record uses the canonical XIP_TEXT_RO address. UI owner thread only, like watchface_manager_delete_watchface.
